audit_scope.description: Batch 4 covers P2P networking (EIP-8077), DNS discovery (EIP-1459), wallet RPC APIs (EIP-2256), calldata pricing (EIP-2028), and EOF container validation (EIP-7692). Most are internal EL operations with EOF validation representing contract deployment boundary.

trusted_external_entities.name: Contract Deployer via JSON-RPC
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: JSON-RPC API (contract creation transactions with EOF bytecode)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated RPC endpoint. EOF bytecode must undergo extensive static validation: magic bytes (0xEF00), container structure, code section opcode validity (EIP-3670), stack validation (EIP-5450), and function call graph verification (EIP-4750, EIP-6206). Invalid EOF containers are rejected at deployment.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: EOF container validation must be complete and sound: (1) Header structure validation (magic 0xEF00, version, section headers), (2) Code section validation (valid opcodes per EIP-3670, no undefined opcodes), (3) Static stack analysis (no underflow/overflow on any path per EIP-5450), (4) Function call graph validation (CALLF/RETF/JUMPF validity per EIP-4750/6206), (5) Data section bounds checking. Deployment fails if any validation fails.
